items.html:
Kevin is built like a typical fast bowler from the Caribbean, standing 6ft 5 inches tall, and takes the new ball for Bermuda. He attended the ICC Winter Training Camp in 2006 in Pretoria and with several young quick bowlers being named in Bermuda's World Cup squad his role will extend to passing on his knowledge as well as setting the example on the field. He is a useful late-order batsman and a respectable fielder.
Alan Curr February 2007
